title: Two of China's Ancient Capitals, 90 Minutes Apart by Bullet Train | China Travel Expert
description:
Two of China's great ancient capitals, linked by a 350 km/h bullet train just 90 minutes apart.

Xi'an and Luoyang were both imperial capitals of China more than a thousand years ago — Xi'an is home to the Terracotta Army, Luoyang to the Longmen Grottoes. Today the Zhengzhou–Xi'an high-speed line ties them together: G-trains run at up to 350 km/h and cover the roughly 380 km in about 90 minutes, with around 96 departures a day. It's one of the easiest heritage day-trips in the country — you barely have to plan ahead.

🧭 Expert Tip: Book the G-trains (the fastest class) on the official 12306 app or on Trip.com, and carry your passport — for foreign travelers it doubles as your ticket ID at the station gate.
